Package hadur.bench

Class HostWidth

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.HostWidth
final class HostWidth extends Object
BENCH-105: --parallel auto, --cpu-constant auto and --shard K/N. The widths come from the queue runner, which sizes the bench to the machine (hostprofile.py) and hands every step HADUR_BENCH_WORKERS_DUEL, _TEAM, _MELEE and HADUR_BENCH_CPU_CONSTANT; run by hand with none of those set, auto falls back to a quarter of the logical processors (12 on the PC, the old bench-top20 default) and to the engine's own calibration. Detection itself lives in one place, hostprofile.py.
